correctness.rationale: SRG spectral decomposition yields projector formulas E6=J/16, E2=(A+2I)/4-J/8 and E-2=(2I-A)/4+J/16. A dark mode is precisely an adjacency eigenvector vanishing on detectors; no such mode iff the finite dissipative semigroup decays for every strictly positive loss assignment. Multiplicity nine of -2 eigenspace forces |T|>=9. Inspection of check_exact.cpp and check_krylov.cpp confirms exhaustive loops over all 11,440 subsets per graph and two different exact rank algorithms, not merely logs. Independent construction of each graph and direct 22,880 principal-matrix rank calculations reproduced every row: rook D=0,1,2 counts 3936/6736/768; Shrikhande 7200/4144/96. Matched induced patterns have identical restricted spectral Gram matrices; the isometry extends blockwise. Results only for uniform hopping, one particle and eventual absorption.
